mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MBR_PRM_STK ( MBR_PRM_STK_ID , PRM_STK_ID , EMIL_ADDR) VALUES ( 'MPS' || '-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('MBR_PRM_STK_PK_SEQ')::text, 6, '0') , #{prmStkId} , #{emilAddr} )
mapper.select: SELECT MPS.MBR_PRM_STK_ID , PS.PRM_STK_ID , MPS.EMIL_ADDR , PS.PRM_STK FROM MBR_PRM_STK MPS JOIN PRM_STK PS ON PS.PRM_STK_ID = MPS.PRM_STK_ID WHERE MPS.EMIL_ADDR = #{_parameter}

SELECT MPS.MBR_PRM_STK_ID , PS.PRM_STK_ID , MPS.EMIL_ADDR , PS.PRM_STK FROM MBR_PRM_STK MPS JOIN PRM_STK PS ON PS.PRM_STK_ID = MPS.PRM_STK_ID WHERE MPS.EMIL_ADDR IN (SELECT EMIL_ADDR FROM MBR_INFO WHERE CMP_ID = #{_parameter})
